title: rubus aureolus
intro: Rubus aureolus, commonly known as the Golden Raspberry, is a type of raspberry plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including being a source of antioxidants, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rubus aureolus are believed to be due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents of Rubus aureolus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
